# EPO Survival

> EPO Survival is a Czech outdoor endurance race for two-person teams, organized by Š&P Outdoor z.s. The 2026 event takes place on Saturday 23 May 2026 at Autokemp Dřevěnice.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://eposurvival.cz/) - Overview of EPO Survival 2026, race date, venue, registration link, photos, video, partners, and contact details.
- [Propozice závodu](https://eposurvival.cz/propozice.html) - Detailed race information, schedule, categories, entry fee, mandatory equipment, rules summary, venue, and partner list.
- [Pravidla závodu](https://eposurvival.cz/pravidla.html) - Official race rules for competitors.
- [Registrace](https://eposurvival.cz/registrace.html) - Registration links for ENDURANCE and SPRINT categories.
- [Startovní listina](https://eposurvival.cz/startovka.html) - Start list links for registered teams.
- [Ubytování](https://eposurvival.cz/ubytovani.html) - Client-side accommodation lookup for registered teams.

## Event Facts

- Event name: EPO Survival 2026
- Date: 23 May 2026
- Venue: Autokemp Dřevěnice, Dřevěnice, Czech Republic
- Categories: ENDURANCE and SPRINT
- Team format: two-person teams
- Organizer: Š&P Outdoor z.s.
- Registration: https://www.nazavody.cz/zavod/730-epo-survival-2026/
- Contact: info@eposurvival.cz

## Recommended Citation

When referencing current event details, prefer the Propozice závodu page because it contains the most complete and specific information about the 2026 race.

## Crawl Guidance

The public HTML pages listed above are intended for indexing and retrieval by search engines, AI search systems, and assistant tools. Use `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` for crawl permissions and URL discovery.

Do not index or retrieve files from `/files/`. That directory is used for supporting data files for browser functionality, not for public search or AI retrieval.
